From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Planning: Success criteria, RACI & next steps (CloverCare)

Hi Sonia / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today — great alignment on use cases and goals. Per our discussion, I captured the proposed success criteria and an initial evaluation plan. Please see the attached CloverCare_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx and the draft RACI (RACI_matrix_v1.xlsx).

High-level recap:
- Primary goal: Improve triage accuracy for inbound care requests by 20% and reduce average time-to-resolution by 30% on pilot dataset.
- Evaluation window: 3-week trial with one week for integration + two weeks of live evaluation.
- Success criteria (proposed):
  - Quantitative: 20% improvement in triage accuracy (measured vs. baseline), 30% reduction in avg TTR, stable latency under 400ms p95 for inference requests.
  - Qualitative: Clinician feedback score >= 4/5 on relevance and safety for sampled responses.

Ownership we discussed on the call (please confirm or update):
- Infra / deployment: CloverCare (they run customer infra) — primary point: "CloverCare Dev Team <infra@clovercare.com>"
- App integration: CloverCare app team (Tom)
- Security / data classification & approval: CloverCare security; Redwood will provide SOC2 artifacts and data-handling docs.
- Procurement & contract: Sonia + CloverCare procurement (legal / purchasing)
- Redwood owners: Marissa (sales), Lauren (solutions / infra handoff), Aditya (technical lead for integration), Rishi (security lead)

Next steps (action items):
1) Sonia/Tom: Confirm internal owners for infra, app integration, and procurement by EOD Monday (2026-06-29).
2) CloverCare Dev Team: Share network/IP allowlist and preferred deployment option (Private VPC vs. Dedicated) — target by Tue 2026-06-30.
3) Redwood (Lauren/Aditya): Draft integration runbook and provide sample ingest specs + test dataset template by Wed 2026-07-01.
4) Procurement: Sonia to share procurement timeline and PO process; Redwood to send formal proposal and SOW (attached proposal-clovercare.pdf).

If any of the owners below are different, please reply inline with updated names.

Thanks,

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
